name: distribute by key value
mechanism: use the key itself (or a digit or bucket of it) as an address: count or bucket elements by key, then read the buckets out in key order, repeating per digit for long keys

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Counting sort' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Sequence algorithms / Sequence sorting:
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Postman sort': variant of Bucket sort which takes advantage of hierarchical structure
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Radix sort': sorts strings letter by letter

requires: keys that map to a bounded integer range or fixed-width digits
fails_when: arbitrary comparison keys are not addressable
